note: Niobrara County (WY) publishes no queryable zoning district layer. The county's planning page links a land use plan and zoning manual, not a district service. The largest town, Lusk, publishes its zoning only as a static 2011 overall-map PDF on townofluskwy.gov, with no GIS viewer or ArcGIS service. ArcGIS search for zoning in the county and Lusk found nothing usable. The county assessor's parcel data (shapefile by request, \$500) has no zoning fields. Manville was not checked in depth.
